papers.headline: Can Fingers of God be Resummed?
papers.summary: Fingers of God (FoGs), Doppler shifts due to the small-scale virial motions of galaxies, are one of the most significant challenges for analytic models of galaxy clustering in redshift surveys.
papers.title: Can Fingers of God be Resummed?

papers.headline: A temperate sub-Neptune transiting the M4 Dwarf TOI-210 identified by NIRPS and TESS – Uncovering hidden M-dwarf planetary systems in the near-infrared
papers.summary: Super-Earths and sub-Neptunes dominate the exoplanet population, yet their compositions, formation mechanisms, and capability of retaining atmospheres remain poorly understood.
papers.title: A temperate sub-Neptune transiting the M4 Dwarf TOI-210 identified by NIRPS and TESS – Uncovering hidden M-dwarf planetary systems in the near-infrared

papers.headline: Fast radio burst - persistent radio source systems III. The relation bewteen PRS luminosity and FRB rotation measure
papers.summary: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio transients of extragalactic origin whose physical origin remains uncertain.
papers.title: Fast radio burst - persistent radio source systems III. The relation bewteen PRS luminosity and FRB rotation measure
